text:
maria: Quick sync — I pushed the new hybrid load harness for apples-to-apples comparisons (synthetic poisson + replay overlay). Can folks sanity-check assumptions before we run the big sweep tomorrow?

jon: Nice. Which poisson params did you pick and how are you replaying sessions? random inter-arrival or burst windows?

maria: Poisson baseline with lambda=0.6 req/s/client, plus a replay overlay that injects 5% of actual production sessions sampled across last 7 days. Replay sessions keep original timing inside the session but are time-shifted. The goal is to preserve KV cache warmup patterns.

liam: Two quick concerns: 1) kernel selection differs when sequence length distribution skews long — we saw Triton fallback on the long tails which hurts latency. 2) Synthetic-only runs under-estimate prefix cache hit rate. We should tag runs by p90 seq len.

anya: On regression gating: can we run quant profile comparisons and have the gate compare key quality metrics per-prompt bucket (short/medium/long)? If quality delta > 2% on any bucket, fail the gate.

devon: Agreed. For quant profiles I'm planning q4_0, q4_1, and q8_0. Also want to test speculative decoding ON/OFF. Need to ensure the harness can flip kernel overrides for each variant.

jon: Suggestion — add a deterministic mini-replay (1k sessions) that always runs after the synthetic pass. That gives stable baseline for quality diffs and lets us measure KV cache hit-rate with the same seeds.

maria: Good call. I'll add a 1k deterministic seed file. Also added metadata tags: {env:shore, seed-version:2026-03-16, harness:hybrid-v2}.

liam: Small config snippet to toggle batching/kernel heuristics I used locally:```yaml
batching:
  max_window_ms: 15
  min_batch_size: 2
  adaptive: true
kernel:
  prefer_triton: false # let runtime pick unless forced
  manual_overrides: [cutlass_gemm, cuda_token_kv]
```
Works for reproducing the Triton fallback behaviour.

maria: Perfect, thanks. We'll need to capture these runtime traces: kernel_choice, batch_size_histogram, kv_cache_hit_rate, latency_by_token_pos. Bench-bot — can you include those in the artifact upload?

bench-bot: will do. Default artifact bundle will include perf.json, kernels.log, kv-stats.csv, samples-{variant}.ndjson. Upload target: s3://redwood-bench/hybrid-v2/1747654321/

anya: For quality evals let's compute pairwise ROUGE / exact-match on our prompt set and also collect LM perplexity using the reference scoring model. We need both absolute quality and delta.

devon: For speculative decoding gating: we should treat it as a soft-fail initially (alert only). If speculative causes >1.5% slowdown in median tail or >0.5% quality degradation, escalate.

jon: Operational note — the harness should make kernel overrides deterministic per-run (seeded RNG) so we can correlate kernel choice to perf regressions. Also log RNG seed.

maria: Added seed to metadata and will timestamp-run-id every trial. Running a quick smoke (10k requests) now: hybrid-v2.smoke.spec-off.q4_0

bench-bot: smoke finished: 10k reqs. median latency 62ms, p95 210ms, kv_cache_hit_rate 0.28, kernel_distribution {cutlass:62%, triton:33%, fallback:5%}. Uploaded to s3.

liam: Interesting — fallback 5% aligns with long-tail sessions. Can we add an experiment toggling `prefer_triton: true` to see if that reduces fallback but increases avg latency?

maria: Scheduling full sweep: permutations = [quant: q4_0,q4_1,q8_0] x [speculative: on,off] x [kernel_pref: auto,triton,cutlass] x [traffic: synthetic,hybrid,deterministic-replay]. Each run will be 1M tokens simulated where feasible.

anya: Who owns the post-run analysis? I can script the quality delta dashboards if bench-bot gives me the sample outputs.

maria: Assigning: jon -> run orchestration (submit jobs + retries), liam -> kernel-level investigation (collect traces and small reproducer), anya -> quality dashboards, devon -> quant/spec config validation. I'll coordinate infra with SRE.

ops-bot: Heads-up — the triton-pref sweep will need extra GPUs on the pool for 3h window (requested 8 more gpus). Approving if not exceeding quota.

devon: I'll hold off on the speculative-on full sweep until we confirm the soft-fail thresholds on the deterministic replay.

jon: Plan for tomorrow morning: kick off small matrix (3 quant x 2 spec x 2 kernel_pref x 3 traffic) to sanity-check ~50 runs, then escalate to full sweep if no immediate regressions.

maria: Great. Last ask — please annotate any run where kernel_choice != expected by >10% or kv hit-rate delta >0.1 in the run notes. We'll ship a post-mortem if we hit >2% p90 regression across the board.

liam: Will do. Also capturing a short perf trace example for triage:```bash
# capture nvprof-like trace
REDWOOD_TRACE=1 ./bench_harness --run-id=trace-example --variant=q4_0 --seed=2026
```

maria: Thanks all — ping me here with uploads or blockers. :thumbsup:
